# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

completion:
Include field measurements and digital photos.
3. Set up a Word document.
4. Fill it in based on your experience and observations.


## 1. Start with the maintenance records

First, try to find a copy of the original contract plans to review drawings for details. Second, take a look at [previous reports](https://www.wsdot.wa.gov/publications/manuals/m36-63bridgeMaintenance/BridgeMaintenanceRecordsOverview.htm). This will show what maintenance has been performed in the past and will list both past records of the inspection reports and past reports of maintenance activity. When bridge maintenance has been planned, a project sheet will start a paper trail that must follow the bridge for its lifetime of maintenance. The important items to focus on to find maintenance are, but not limited to, the inspection reports and the maintenance reports.

- [Search the maintenance inspector's database](http://ma
